The integration of these pathways implies a possible mechanism by which the compound may influence A2780cisR through the FcRn pathway, potentially involving receptor-mediated signaling or trafficking. The evidence suggests a chain of interactions that could be critical in understanding the compound’s biological role, though further validation is needed to confirm the direct involvement of the compound in this process.
